12.madueke_b: and Lot also and his substance, the son of Abrams brother, who dwelled in Sodom.

13.s_dismas: And behold one, that had eſcaped, told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean brother of Eſchol, and the brother of Aner: for theſe had made a league with Abram.
13.odr_com: And behold one, that had escaped, told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean brother of Eschol, and the brother of Aner: for these had made a league with Abram.
13.sabates_a: And behold one that had escaped told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean, brother of Eschol, and the brother of Aner: for these made a league with Abram.
13.madueke_b: And behold one that had escaped told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean, brother of Eschol, and the brother of Aner: for these made a league with Abram.

14.s_dismas: Which when Abram had heard, to witt, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbred of the ſeruantes borne in his houſe, wel appointed three hundred and eightene: and purſued them vnto Dan.
14.odr_com: Which when Abram had heard, to witt, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbred of the seruantes borne in his house, wel appointed three hundred and eightene: and pursued them vnto Dan.
14.sabates_a: Which when Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbered of the servants born in his house, well appointed, three hundred and eighteen: and pursued them unto Dan.
14.madueke_b: Which when Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbered of the servants born in his house, well appointed, three hundred and eighteen: and pursued them unto Dan.

15.s_dismas: And diuiding his companie, he ranne vpon them in the night: and ſtroke them, and purſued them vnto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damaſcus.
15.odr_com: And diuiding his companie, he ranne vpon them in the night: and stroke them, and pursued them vnto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
15.sabates_a: And dividing his company, he ran upon them in the night, and struck them, and pursued them unto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
15.madueke_b: And dividing his company, he ran upon them in the night, and struck them, and pursued them unto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

16.s_dismas: And he brought backe al the ſubſtance, and Lot his brother with his ſubſtance, the wemen alſo and the people.
16.odr_com: And he brought backe al the substance, and Lot his brother with his substance, the wemen also and the people.
16.sabates_a: And he brought back all the substance, and Lot his brother with his substance, the women also and the people.
16.madueke_b: And he brought back all the substance, and Lot his brother with his substance, the women also and the people.

17.s_dismas: And the king of Sodom went forth to meete them, after he returned from the ſlaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kinges that were with him in the vale Sauee, which is the kings vale.
17.odr_com: And the king of Sodom went forth to meete them, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kinges that were with him in the vale Sauee, which is the kings vale.
17.sabates_a: And the king of Sodom went forth to meet them, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kings that were with him in the vale Savee, which is the king's vale.
17.madueke_b: And the king of Sodom went forth to meet them, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kings that were with him in the vale Savee, which is the king's vale.

18.s_dismas: But Melchiſedech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Prieſt of God moſt highe,
18.odr_com: But Melchesidech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Priest of God most highe,
18.sabates_a: But Melchisedech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Priest of God most High,
18.madueke_b: But Melchisedech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Priest of God most High,

19.s_dismas: bleſſed him, and ſaid: Bleſſed be Abram to God the higheſt, which created heauen and earth:
19.odr_com: blessed him, and said: Blessed be Abram to God the highest, which created heauen and earth:
19.sabates_a: blessed him, and said: Blessed be Abram to God the Highest, which created heaven and earth:
19.madueke_b: blessed him, and said: Blessed be Abram to God the Highest, which created heaven and earth:

20.s_dismas: and bleſſed be God the higheſt, by whoſe protection, the enemyes are in thy hands. And he gaue him the tythes of al.
20.odr_com: and blessed be God the highest, by whose protection, the enemyes are in thy hands. And he gaue him the tythes of al.
20.sabates_a: and blessed be God the Highest, by whose protection the enemies are in thy hands. And he gave him the tithes of all.
20.madueke_b: and blessed be God the Highest, by whose protection the enemies are in thy hands. And he gave him the tithes of all.

21.s_dismas: And the king of Sodom ſaid to Abram: Geue me the ſoules, and the reſt take to thee.
21.odr_com: And the king of Sodom said to Abram: Geue me the soules, and the rest take to thee.
21.sabates_a: And the king of Sodom said to Abram: Give me the souls, and the rest take to thee.
21.madueke_b: And the king of Sodom said to Abram: Give me the souls, and the rest take to thee.

22.s_dismas: Who anſwered him: I lift vp my hand to my Lord God moſt hiegh poſſeſſor of heauen and earth,
22.odr_com: Who answered him: I lift vp my hand to my Lord God most hiegh possessor of heauen and earth,
22.sabates_a: Who answered him: I lift up my hand to my Lord God most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
22.madueke_b: Who answered him: I lift up my hand to my Lord God most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

23.s_dismas: that from the very woofe-thread vnto the ſhoe latchet, I wil not take of al that are thine: leſt thou ſay: I haue enriched Abram:
23.odr_com: that from the very woofe-thread vnto the shoe latchet, I wil not take of al that are thine: lest thou say: I haue enriched Abram:
23.sabates_a: that from the very woof-thread unto the shoe latchet, I will not take of all that are thine, lest thou say, I have enriched Abram:
23.madueke_b: that from the very woof-thread unto the shoe latchet, I will not take of all that are thine, lest thou say, I have enriched Abram:

24.s_dismas: except ſuch thinges, as the young men haue eaten, and the ſhares of the men, that came with me, Aner, Eſchol, and Mambre: theſe ſhal take their ſhares.
24.odr_com: except such thinges, as the young men haue eaten, and the shares of the men, that came with me, Aner, Eschol, and Mambre: these shal take their shares.
24.sabates_a: except such things as the young men have eaten, and the shares of the men that came with me, Aner, Eschol, and Mambre: these shall take their shares.
24.madueke_b: except such things as the young men have eaten, and the shares of the men that came with me, Aner, Eschol, and Mambre: these shall take their shares.

janvier_by_verse.1: And it came to pass in that time, that Amraphel the king of Sennaar, and Arioch the king of Pontus, and Chodorlahomor king of the Elamites, and Thadal the king of Nations.
janvier_by_verse.2: made war against Barra the king of Sodome, and against Bersa the king of Gomorra, and against Sennaab the king of Adama, and against Semebar the king of Seboim, and against the king of Bala, the same is Segor.
janvier_by_verse.3: All these came together into the wood-land vale, which now is the salt sea.
janvier_by_verse.4: For they had served Chodorlahomor twelve years, & the thirteenth year they revolted from him.
janvier_by_verse.5: Therefore in the fourteenth year came Chodorlahomor, and the kings that were with him, and they struck Raphaim in Astarothcarnaim, and Susim with them, and Emim in Savee of Cariathaim,
janvier_by_verse.6: and the Corrheans in the mountains of Seir, even to the Champion country of Pharan, which is in the wilderness.
janvier_by_verse.7: And they returned, and came as far as the fountain of Misphat, the same is Cades: and they struck all the country of the Amelechites, and of the Amorrheans, that dwell in Asasonthamar.
janvier_by_verse.8: And they went forth the king of Sodome, and the king of Gomorra, and the king of Adama, and the king of Seboim, moreover also the king of Bala, which is Segor: and they set themselves against them in battle array in the wood-land vale:
janvier_by_verse.9: to wit against Chodorlahomor king of the Elamites, and Thadal king of Nations, and Amraphel king of Sennaar, and Arioch king of Pontus: four kings against five.
janvier_by_verse.10: But the wood-land vale had many pits of bitume. Therefore the king of Sodome and of Gomorra turned their backs, and were overthrown there: and they that remained fled to the mountain.
janvier_by_verse.11: And they took all the substance of the Sodomites and Gomorrheans, and took all kind of victuals, and went their way:
janvier_by_verse.12: and Lot also and his substance, the son of Abrams brother, who dwelled in Sodom.
janvier_by_verse.13: And behold one that had escaped told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean, brother of Eschol, and the brother of Aner: for these made a league with Abram.
janvier_by_verse.14: Which when Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbered of the servants born in his house, well appointed, three hundred and eighteen: and pursued them unto Dan.
janvier_by_verse.15: And dividing his company, he ran upon them in the night, and struck them, and pursued them unto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
janvier_by_verse.16: And he brought back all the substance, and Lot his brother with his substance, the women also and the people.
janvier_by_verse.17: And the king of Sodom went forth to meet them, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kings that were with him in the vale Savee, which is the king's vale.
janvier_by_verse.18: But Melchisedech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Priest of God most High,
janvier_by_verse.19: blessed him, and said: Blessed be Abram to God the Highest, which created heaven and earth:
janvier_by_verse.20: and blessed be God the Highest, by whose protection the enemies are in thy hands. And he gave him the tithes of all.
janvier_by_verse.21: And the king of Sodom said to Abram: Give me the souls, and the rest take to thee.
janvier_by_verse.22: Who answered him: I lift up my hand to my Lord God most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
janvier_by_verse.23: that from the very woof-thread unto the shoe latchet, I will not take of all that are thine, lest thou say, I have enriched Abram:
janvier_by_verse.24: except such things as the young men have eaten, and the shares of the men that came with me, Aner, Eschol, and Mambre: these shall take their shares.
